EVALUATION MODEL
Overall Binary Outcome
The evaluator records one overall outcome, using two labels the program defines. Defaults to Met / Unmet.
Question-Level Qualitative
The evaluator answers Yes/No against each program-defined question.
Scored / Likert
The evaluator scores each question on the program-configured scale.
Demonstration-Level Outcome
The evaluator records the level of supervision the demonstration needed.
This model records one outcome per evaluation, so question-level responses are not available. To capture Yes/No per question, choose Question-Level Qualitative; to capture scores, choose Scored / Likert.
Response options
Two outcomes, worded however the program words them. The model stays binary.
QUALIFYING OUTCOME
*
Counts as evidence toward achievement.
NON-QUALIFYING OUTCOME
*
Recorded, but does not count toward achievement.
Both outcomes need a label.
Common alternatives:
Met / Unmet
Pass / Fail
Satisfactory / Needs Improvement
Competent / Not Yet Competent
Renaming these changes the wording everywhere — the evaluation form, the evidence history and the reports. Existing evidence keeps its meaning; only the label it displays under changes.
Evaluation qualification
Defines when a single completed evaluation counts as evidence toward achievement.
An evaluation qualifies when the preceptor records Met. No further configuration applies.
